theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid n)) (φ u g : Euclid n → ℝ), MeasurableSet S → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∫ y, φ y = 1 → IntegrableOn u S → Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ x, x ∉ S → g x = 0) → ∫ x, (u x - ∫ y in S, u y * φ (x - y)) * g x = ∫ z, φ z * ∫ y in S, u y * (g y - g (y + z))
